payload.claim: The spec declares `risk: standard` but its `touches` include `saffron/gates/core/scope.py` and `saffron/gates/suite.py` (under `saffron/gates/**`) and `saffron/cell/worktree.py` (under `saffron/cell/**`), both `elevate_on` entries in this repo's policy, so `effective_risk` will compute `elevated` at runtime, making `size` blocking rather than advisory for this attempt despite the declared field. This matches established precedent in this repo (e.g. SA-0351) and the measured prototype diff (735 tokens) sits comfortably under the feature ceiling (3000) either way, so no gate actually blocks on it.
